declared.constants: 3-year window, 1000 draws, minimum 3 events: chosen, no external source
declared.null: event years redrawn uniformly without replacement from the same country's series years that have a full lead window; 1000 draws; seed 20261124
declared.question: do resource-stress changes lead policy / conflict events beyond a shuffled-date null?
declared.refusals: a country with fewer than 3 dated events -> NOT RUN (too few events). No events file -> NOT RUN.
declared.report: per country: observed statistic, null mean, null 5th and 95th percentile, share of null draws >= observed, n events. No pooled verdict.
declared.statistic: mean stress_change over the lead window (years e-3 .. e-1) across a country's events
declared.stress_change: per country and year t: the largest year-on-year rise in net import balance across oil, gas and coal, max_f(balance_f[t] - balance_f[t-1]). Balance is used, not the unbounded share, so one exporter year cannot dominate.
